The group's media centre (English and Arabic) and the state news agency refused automated access, so no Arabic listing was read and nothing from 2022-2023 or from 2026 was enumerated. The lane's five declared queries were not run: the task assigned the whole search allowance to BH3. This is a count of items read, not a census.

lanes.limitation: Both listings were read in full by title and date (Arabic 79 of 79, English 69 of 69); no title concerned a supply interruption, so no item was opened. The listings begin in February 2024, so 2022 and 2023 cannot be enumerated here and rest on the lane's four declared queries, which were not run: the task assigned the whole search allowance to BH3.

lanes.source_family: Arabic and English media by year, via search

Fifteen result pages were requested and thirteen read. Domestic Arabic papers were not reached (two are refused, the readable one has no search); every page read is foreign or English-language press carrying an official Bahraini statement. This is a count of records found.

Seen in result lists and not pursued: 2024 Shanxi safety-inspection output curbs (a regulatory campaign, not a discrete event), two mine accidents of 23 Oct 2024 in Hebei and Shanxi, and a reported 2024 output fall in one Heilongjiang city.

recovery_by_class.note: Days from the event to a dated report that recovery was complete. Partial restorations and dates that are only the date of a report are left out, as is any group seen in just one country. Fewer than three cases are listed, three or four give a range, five or more a median. These describe what was reported and are not a forecast or a country comparison.
